meta.authority: Ministry of Awqaf and Islamic Affairs (awqaf.gov.jo), via Wayback Machine captures
meta.capture_agent: c40-wayback (wb.py/wb2.py CDX sweeps; master series deduplicated by date)
notes: Source times are 12-hour with no AM/PM markers, padded or unpadded; conversion applied: fajr/sunrise/dhuhr kept as printed (fajr and sunrise are ante-meridiem, dhuhr hours 11-12), asr/maghrib/isha +12h. All input hours checked within expected sets before conversion; all output rows pass dawn-to-dark ordering.

Four surfaces: pre-rebuild monthly sheets (2012-2013, 245d), server-rendered grid (2021-2026, 184d), printed 2025 almanac decoded from PDF content streams (140d of 2025), today+9 live grid (2026, 10d).
2012-2013 pre-rebuild CMS prints a systemically different horizon pair (sunrise one minute later, maghrib one minute earlier) than the modern engine; rows are verbatim from that era.
Scattered coverage: days are the union of captured windows, not continuous years.
All 579 days recipe-verified in c40-wayback REPORT.md: every modern day within one minute; 2012 holds four 2-minute rows (dhuhr/maghrib).
